query-mapping.description: Build variables for a build recipe

property.name: secret
property.comment: whether the build variable is secret.

query.name: build-variables
query.comment: Environment variables to build a recipe. List is sorted on the overriding precedence: - recipe specific variables are put first, - branch specific variables are put, - project specific variables are put, - node specific variables are put, - global variables are put last.
query.sql: SELECT env.name AS name, env.value AS value, env.kind AS kind, env.secret AS secret, env.step_number AS step FROM porion_environment AS env WHERE env.recipe_id = :recipe_id OR (env.recipe_id IS NULL AND (env.branch_id = :branch_id AND (env.node_id = :node_id OR env.node_id IS NULL))) OR (env.recipe_id IS NULL AND env.branch_id IS NULL AND (env.project_id = :project_id AND (env.node_id = :node_id OR env.node_id IS NULL))) OR (env.recipe_id IS NULL AND env.branch_id IS NULL AND (env.project_id IS NULL AND env.node_id = :node_id)) OR (env.recipe_id IS NULL AND env.branch_id IS NULL AND env.project_id IS NULL AND env.node_id IS NULL) ORDER by COALESCE(env.recipe_id,0) DESC, COALESCE(env.branch_id,0) DESC, COALESCE(env.project_id,0) DESC, COALESCE(env.node_id, 0) DESC;
